events.title: Amalgamation of Northern and Southern Protectorates
events.description: In 1914, the British merged the Northern and Southern Protectorates to form Nigeria.

events.title: Nigeria Gains Independence
events.description: On October 1st, 1960, Nigeria gained independence from Britain with Nnamdi Azikiwe as Governor-General.

events.title: Nigerian Civil War
events.description: A three-year conflict (1967–1970) between the Nigerian government and Biafra, leading to over 1 million deaths.

events.title: Transition to Democracy
events.description: On May 29th, 1999, Nigeria transitioned from military rule to civilian democracy with Olusegun Obasanjo sworn in as president.
